source_rule_catalog.B_V2_INTERVENTION_SCOPE: B v2 selected EB device types after access/control review; not the whole synthetic ownership inventory
source_rule_catalog.D_V2_DEVICE_INJECTION: D actual private-device injection and selected AC zones in the reviewed ten-day inputs
source_rule_catalog.A_V2_H6: A v2 synthetic household-attributed H6-like building area, not observed area
source_rule_catalog.C_V2_GEOMETRY: C v2 modeled full-unit and household zone areas, including declared experimental ratios
source_rule_catalog.EXPERIMENTAL_V2_AREA_RATIO: Declared v2 area design ratio; not a measured dwelling ratio
source_rule_catalog.C_V2_SOURCE_PROTOTYPE: C selected source building prototype; not an observed household building type
source_rule_catalog.C_V2_CATALOG_YEAR_PROXY: C source catalog vintage used as a synthetic category; not observed construction year
source_rule_catalog.B_V2_BACKGROUND_APPLIANCE_SCENARIO: Explicit synthetic background appliance scenario outside the EB meter
source_rule_catalog.C_V2_SOURCE_FLOOR_ROOF: C selected source unit floor and roof surfaces, not household field observation
source_rule_catalog.B_V2_TENURE_SCENARIO: Explicit synthetic tenure assignment conditional on v2 housing form

scope_note: source_ids identify supporting constructs or explicit design inputs; per-role value comes from the listed generation rule and selected B profile, not a sampled human answer
